title: The A-Team
description:

B.A. and Murdock help a diner owner and his daughter fight a corrupt tycoon who wants their land for an off-ramp.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S4 E12 — The First
Banner investigates legends of another scientist, dead 30 years, who underwent a Hulk-type metamorphosis.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S5 E4 — Sanctuary
To save a wounded immigrant boy, Banner poses as a visiting priest; guests Henry Darrow, Diana Muldaur.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S4 E18 — Patterns
A factory owner in debt to the mob labels Banner as his partner.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S5 E7 — A Minor Problem
Banner seeks an antidote for bacteria contaminating a deserted town; guest Nancy Grahn.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S4 E16 — Half Nelson
A wrestler's exaggerated boasts get Banner in trouble with the mob.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 E15 — Buyout
Michael and KITT battle saboteurs to help workers in an armored-limousine factory save their company.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S3 E16 — Knightlines
Michael and K.I.T.T. uncover an international criminal's plans to detonate a partially completed high-rise building.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E2 — The Wedworth Townsend Act
An assembly bill to create a paramedic program meets opposition from doctors and firefighters; pilot for the series.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E3 — Mascot
Gage promises to care for an injured woman's dog; the paramedics save five lives including a diabetic and a man trapped on a ledge.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E4 — Botulism
An injured cameraman proves to have more than a broken leg, leading Brackett to search for a botulism source; guest Susan Seaforth.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E5 — Cook's Tour
DeSoto and Gage deliver a baby over the father's protests; DeSoto worries about a dinner he is planning for the station-house crew.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E6 — Brushfire
A canyon fire threatens the residents of a housing development and keeps the paramedics on round-the-clock duty; guest Tony Dow.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E7 — Dealer's Wild
DeSoto and Gage talk down an airplane flown by a teenage boy whose father, the pilot, suffered a heart attack while at the controls.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E8 — Nurses Wild
The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: Emergency!
description:

Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E10 — Weird Wednesday
The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E11 — Dilemma
Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E15 — The Big Squeeze
The team works from a pub to stop a loan shark (Joseph Sirola) from terrorizing small businesses; guest Wings Hauser.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E16 — Champ!
To stop a mobster's takeover of local boxing events, Hannibal sets up a syndicate with B.A. fighting as Volcano Johnson.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E17 — Skins
Infatuated B.A. volunteers the team to help a Kenyan game warden (Daphne Maxwell) find the poachers who killed her brother.
